svg.title: Career graph as git log: over 10 years where business meets data, in e-commerce. 2024 - currently: Analytics Engineer (data pipelines and an analysis-ready warehouse (Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt); a pricing algorithm for multiple European markets; profitability monitoring with costs down to product level; language model integrations in company processes). 2022 - 2024: Data Analyst (Python apps for pricing policy and product data quality; automated supplier orders; algorithms for product bundles and sorting for revenue and margin; integration of competitor pricing data). 2018 - 2022: Business Analyst (advanced SQL and data pipelines; tools for sales, orders, products and accounting (Google Apps Script); ERP rollout: process analysis, data migration, testing). 2016 - 2018: Stock Optimization Manager, then Sales & Business Analysis Manager (sales forecasts and seasonal purchase planning; stock turnover and clearance strategies; leading a small analytics team and setting KPIs). Education 2024 - 2026: Postgraduate studies in Data Science (Advanced Data Analytics), Wroclaw University of Economics and Business.
